emails.subject: Query - Protocol XYZ123 - Site 101 - Unblinding & Transition to Part C
emails.body:
Hi David,

Hope you are having a good week.

We have a patient (101-004) who is approaching their final visit in the double-blind Part B of the study. We are preparing for their potential transition to the open-label extension (Part C) and would appreciate some clarification on the specific procedures.

Could you please provide a step-by-step guide or point us to the exact section in the protocol/pharmacy manual that details the unblinding process within the IXRS system? We want to ensure we follow the correct procedure for unblinding the patient's Part B treatment assignment and transitioning them to the open-label drug supply for Part C.

Any specific guidance on documentation requirements for this transition would also be very helpful.

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,

Sarah Jenkins, CCRC
Clinical Research Coordinator
University Health Center
Site 101

emails.subject: RE: Query - Protocol XYZ123 - Site 101 - Unblinding & Transition to Part C
emails.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for reaching out and for your proactive planning. This is an important process to get right.

The detailed procedures for unblinding and transitioning to Part C are outlined in Protocol v4.0, Section 8.5. I have also attached a quick reference guide that our team created which summarizes the IXRS steps.

In short, the process is as follows:
1.  Confirm all Part B end-of-treatment assessments are complete and the patient has consented for Part C.
2.  The designated unblinded site staff (e.g., Pharmacist) must log into the IXRS.
3.  Navigate to the 'Unblinding' module for patient 101-004.
4.  Follow the on-screen prompts to confirm the unblinding request. The system will then reveal the treatment assignment from Part B.
5.  This event must be documented on the Unblinding Log and in the patient's source notes.
6.  Once unblinded, you can then proceed with the 'Transition to Open-Label' workflow in IXRS to have the first Part C drug kit assigned.

Please ensure the eCRF is updated accordingly to reflect the completion of Part B and the start of Part C.

Let me know if you have any further questions after reviewing the attached guide.

Best,

David Chen
Clinical Research Associate
Innovate Pharma

We will review the materials thoroughly and proceed as instructed for the patient's upcoming visit.

Best regards,

Sarah Jenkins, CCRC

University Health Center
Site 101
